title: Bounded tensor preparation for the boundary direct-image comparison
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, an integer $n\ge1$, and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ be a closed immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-closed-immersion]. Use ordinary constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], $l=i_e^*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and $C_W=\nu_W^*$ [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Let $r\le s$ and $u\le v$ be integers. Let $B\in D^b_c(Z_e,A)$ satisfy $\mathcal H^j(B)=0$ for $j\notin[r,s]$, and let $M\in D^b_c(T_e,A)$ have Tor amplitude $[u,v]$: for every degree-zero $A$-module sheaf $V$, $\mathcal H^j(M\otimes_A^LV)=0$ for $j\notin[u,v]$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].
There exist a complex $B^\bullet$ representing $B$, zero outside $[r,s]$, and a complex $V^\bullet$ representing $M$, with flat terms and zero outside $[u,v]$, such that $V^\bullet$ and its termwise pullback $lV^\bullet$ are K-flat and $lV^\bullet$ represents $lM$. Flat means that tensoring with a term is exact; K-flat means that total tensor with any acyclic complex is acyclic [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules, def-pc-kflat-complex]. The signed total complex
$$\operatorname{Tot}(B^\bullet\otimes_A lV^\bullet)^d=\bigoplus_{j+h=d}B^j\otimes_A lV^h,$$
with differential $d_B\otimes1+(-1)^j1\otimes d_{lV}$ on bidegree $(j,h)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], represents $Q=B\otimes_A^LlM$ and is zero outside $[r+u,s+v]$. Thus $Q\in D^b(Z_e,A)\subset D^+(Z_e,A)$ with precisely that cohomological bound. Its canonical direct-image mate
$$b_Q:C_TRi_{e,*}Q\longrightarrow Ri_{p,*}C_ZQ$$
of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] is defined and invertible. No finite Tor amplitude is required of $B$, and the flat terms of $V^\bullet$ are not asserted to be locally free. These assertions include $Z=\varnothing$, zero inputs and intervals with equal endpoints.

source.place: Tag 0G7E, lemma-pullback-K-flat; the etale finite-Tor flat-model clause of lem-sf-flat-model supplies the bounded input, followed by its tensor with a bounded representative.

proof.text: Convert the given homology-tested Tor amplitude to the canonical t-structure Tor amplitude with DerivedCategory.hasTorAmplitudeIn_iff_torAmplitudeIn. Apply the already proved generic source DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_flat_of_torAmplitudeIn in the ordinary module-valued etale sheaf category, at the same lifted coefficient ring. Obtain V supported in [u,v], termwise categorically flat, and an isomorphism Q(V) ≅ M. Categorical flatness supplies the required exact tensorRight functors directly. No constructibility hypothesis is needed for this auxiliary construction.

Take lV to be the literal degreewise upperStar of V. Exact inverse image preserves zero terms. The source upperStarPreservesFlat_moduleCat instance, proved by the geometric-fiber criterion [lem-sfb-etale-flat-geometric-fibers], preserves its flat terms. Both V and lV are supported in [u,v], so the already proved generic CochainComplex.kFlat_of_bounded_of_flat gives their quasi-isomorphism-localizer K-flatness. Apply mapDerivedCategory to M ≅ Q(V) and compose with mapDerivedCategoryFactors at V to identify lM with Q(lV).

The cohomology bounds on B give IsGE r and IsLE s. Apply [lem-sfb-bounded-representative] in ordinary module-valued etale sheaves to obtain B-prime supported in [r,s] and eB:B ≅ Q(B-prime). The already proved generic source DerivedCategory.QObjTensorQObjIsoOfKFlatRight identifies Q(B-prime) tensor Q(lV) with Q(Tot(B-prime tensor lV)); compose with tensorIso eB elV. This is the one-sided K-flat normalization in the actual category of the item, and requires no flatness or Tor condition on B.

Prove strict support directly by mapBifunctor.hom_ext. A total summand has j+h=d. If d is outside [r+u,s+v], then either j is outside [r,s] or h is outside [u,v]; the corresponding term is zero, and additive tensor functors preserve zero objects. Thus the identity on the total term is zero. Convert this strict vanishing into IsStrictlyGE and IsStrictlyLE. The derived image of a strictly bounded complex has the same t-structure bounds; transport these across the tensor comparison with TStructure.isGE_of_iso and isLE_of_iso. Their homology characterizations give the requested cohomology bound, and choose Q in D-plus with exactly the actual tensor as underlying object.

proof.text: A closed immersion is finite, hence proper and quasi-compact; it is separated, hence quasi-separated [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper, lem-pc-separated-quasi-separated]. The specified coefficient ring is finite [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Apply isIso_fixedComparisonDirectImageMatePlus to i and take its component at the actual Q [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. Assemble the representatives, bounds, isomorphisms and invertibility. All arithmetic uses weak bounds, so zero inputs, empty schemes and singleton intervals are included.
